## Manufacturing Capability

- In-house PVC formulation development based on samples, drawings and performance targets.
- Factory production flow covering formulation discussion, sample trial, raw material mixing, extrusion pelletizing, cooling, screening, packing, delivery and batch traceability.
- Retained samples for each batch to support long-term color and performance consistency.
- First sample trial cycle is usually 3-7 working days.
- Typical MOQ for mature formulas is often 500 kg to 1 ton; new custom formulas can start from small trial batches after discussion.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How should PVC wire and cable compound be selected?
A: Selection depends on application, cable structure, operating temperature, flame-retardant grade, compliance requirements, color, hardness, processing method and expected volume.

Q: What is the difference between 70°C and 105°C PVC compound?
A: Higher temperature ratings require stronger heat-aging stability and a different formulation balance. Cost and processing behavior may also change.

Q: Where is -40°C cold-resistant PVC compound used?
A: It is used for outdoor wiring in cold regions, agricultural machinery cable, cold storage equipment, winter construction cable and low-temperature projects.

Q: Can PVC sheath compound and insulation compound be used interchangeably?
A: They should not be casually interchanged. Insulation compound focuses on electrical performance, while sheath compound focuses on protection, appearance, flexibility and service environment.

Q: How to contact the factory?
A: Tel / WeChat 13450853338.
